bodySchema.description: Payload required to create a new Element (Asset)

nfc_code.description:
Optional NFC code for the Element.
When available, it can help to quickly identify the Element.

bar_code.description:
Optional bar code for the Element.
When available, it can help to quickly identify the Element.

latitude.description:
Optional geographic latitude coordinate for the Element's precise location.
Essential for visualizing where the Element is on the map.
- Required when longitude is filled

longitude.description:
Optional geographic longitude coordinate for the Element's precise location.
Essential for visualizing where the Element is on the map.
- Required when latitude is filled

observation.description: Optional notes, remarks, or additional descriptive information about the Element.

code.description:
Optional code for the Element within its context (e.g., within the Entity or Category).
Useful for quick reference or integration purposes.

category_id.description:
Mandatory ID of the associated Category.
- Must reference a Category from `GET /categories/all`.
- The Category must be of type "TYPE_OF_EQUIPMENT". Categories of type "SOFT_MAINTENANCE" are NOT allowed.

local_id.description:
Mandatory ID of the associated Location (where the Element is situated).
- Must reference a Location from `GET /locations`.
- The Location must be of type "location". Locations of type "building" or "location-folder" are NOT allowed.

maintenance_policy_id.description:
Mandatory ID of the associated Maintenance Policy.
- Must reference a Maintenance Policy from `GET /maintenance-policies`.
- The Maintenance Policy must belong to the same Category specified in `category_id`.

acquisition_cost.description:
Optional acquisition Cost of the element. Required with:
- lifetime
- residual_value

acquisition_date.description:
Optional date (and time) when the Element was acquired (or put into service).
Uses ISO 8601 `date-time` format.

supplier_name.description: Optional name of the vendor or supplier from whom the Element was acquired.

lifetime.description:
Optional expected useful lifetime of the Element in years.
Used for depreciation or replacement planning.
For this field, `acquisition_cost` is required.

residual_value.description:
Optional estimated residual or salvage value of the Element at the end of its useful lifetime.
For this field, `acquisition_cost` is required.

stoppage_cost.description: Optional estimated cost incurred of downtime if this Element fails or stops working.

element_uuid.description:
Optional universal unique identifier (UUID) supplied by the client for the element.
If omitted, the server generates a creation time.
Providing a UUID can support idempotent creation patterns. Allowing offline creation (such as from the mobile app).

observations.description: Specific notes or details related to this individual material's transaction within the batch.

cost_price.description: The cost price associated with this material at the time of the transaction. This is typically the purchase price or standard cost.

operators.description: IDs of the operators assigned to the events

enforce_nfc.description:
Require an NFC tag scan on the assets of this planned job.
What is stored depends on the entity's `enforce-nfc` extension. With it installed and configured as required, a value sent here is honoured and omitting the field stores `true`. Without it, the field is ignored and the planned job is created with `false`. The response carries what was stored, not what was asked for.
